name: Fuyutsuki Kona
source: Shigure's elder twin sister. While their hairstyles are different, their face and body are identical. Her personality is the exact opposite of Shigure, she is very close to others and very optimistic. She is a girl with a natural bright smile. One of her charm is that she loves to tease others but never mean any harm. She is always worried about her antisocial sister.
